ordering_owner_reply.question: Issue #96 leaves one ordering question: when several Injured players compete for the last Hospital place at the same end-of-round, which rule should apply? I’ll record this as unresolved until you decide; other capacity work can continue.
ordering_owner_reply.answer: Free healed Hospital places first, then use existing seat order
ordering_owner_reply.scope: Original issue #96; preserved as the owner authority for healed-first/numeric admission reconciliation; historical tuples unchanged.

decisions.rule: Exactly four physical Hospital positions H1-H4 in all 7/8/9-player matches; all physical occupants including retained bodies count. Other capacities unchanged.

Keep stored Main then Shot effects, Rescue, R3 Supply and due deaths. During the atomic stage new injuries wait at their origin without a physical Hospital position. Free healed Hospital departures first; admit remaining new candidates in numeric seat order before ordinary returns. New second-hit bodies compete in that same order; existing bodies never vacate. Healthy same-batch Rescue recipients return without failed admission. No intermediate projection or persistent waitlist.

A pending new candidate denied admission is permanently Eliminated and offboard, current detention/Captain/medical cleared. Publish only HOSPITAL_OVERFLOW_REMOVED plus ordinary health/placement, no provisional medical facts/anchor for that denied candidate. No later Rescue; complete original identity/Code/accepted actions/resources/receipts/history retained.
Validate private hospitalOverflow phaseId/round against exactly matching authoritative overflow outcome independently of Captain EJECT; no public per-seat cause field and no fabricated Captain use.

Preserve distinct roster-sized HV1-HV7/8/9 clinical namespace and slotCount7/8/9, separate from four physical beds. Reserve starting Hospital occupants including bodies. Every medical wire fact retains its mandatory anchor. A valid HV5+ on the four-bed renderer is words-only after strict validation; never create H5 or silently reuse another subject anchor.

Exact successor layout board-v2-four-0.1.0 and reserved production art design-0.5.0 acknowledged through existing exact FullVersions Ready shape. No default/profile/art activation, migration or historical-byte change.
